caption_or_description: (a) Electric field lines run through space from the positive to the negative terminal of a battery. (b) When a thick metal wire connects the two terminals, an electric field runs through the wire, driving a current, while an electric field is also generated in the space around the wire by charge that accumulates on the wire surface.
The solid lines suggest the random path of an electron jostling about in an atomic lattice; dashed lines suggest the path altered when an electric field is applied.
